name: Snikkit
bio: All teeth, ears and loincloth. Giggles when he reloads, which is somehow worse.
notes: From the owner's T-pose uploads (2026-11-01, "found some new ones"): an unrigged textured GLB, rigged here from T-pose landmarks (arms level; the manifest's landmarks, read off front and side views). Named here; the owner reviews it on the grip and portrait sheets. Not the shipped Goblin (meshy_goblin, rags and boots): a bare goblin in a loincloth. Replaced 2026-11-05 (intake step 2b, the owner's mapping) by "Goblin Mischief" (Meshy rig, Mixamo skeleton; its clips not used); it was built from T Pose Goblin.
